High Lord '''Halvate Paendrag''' was the son of Empress [[Radhanan Paendrag]].
==History==
Halvate was the only brother that [[Tuon]] actually liked. He was killed by an assassin. While he lived, one of his interests was training wild ''[[grolm]]''.
== Trivia ==
* Halvate is named for Matthew Hlavatay, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
